slides.title: MT1 is a drug
slides.text: Afamelanotide (Scenesse) was approved by the FDA in October 2019 for erythropoietic protoporphyria.

slides.title: MT2 has no approved use
slides.text: Sold online as a 'tanning injection'. Its safety has never been established.

slides.title: Different receptor reach
slides.text: MT1 targets MC1R. MT2 also hits MC3R and MC4R, which are linked to libido and appetite effects.

slides.title: Same name, different substance
slides.text: If a seller says MT2 is 'basically the same as the drug', it isn't.
